name: Fund Filer
shortDescription: UK online Gift Aid and GASDS claim-management software for churches and charities.
suitableContexts: Churches wanting a specialist tool to record Gift Aid donors, donations and claims
Volunteer treasurers or giving secretaries handling Gift Aid and GASDS separately from their accounts package

pricing.summary: Fund Filer advertises pricing from £1.90 per week, payable monthly or annually, with cancellation at any time. Its public price material should be checked for the band that applies to the church's donation volume.

tiers.label: Fund Filer subscription
tiers.detail: Online Gift Aid management; monthly or annual payment is advertised

pricing.trialDetails: A six-week trial without payment details is advertised.

gdprInformation: Fund Filer links to a public privacy policy and terms. As the service holds donor and Gift Aid information, a church should review those current documents, access controls, data export and its own retention responsibilities before use.
coreFeatures: Gift Aid donor and donation records

gbp-pricing.value: Supplier advertises subscriptions from £1.90 per week, payable monthly or annually.

data-processing.value: Supplier links public privacy and service-term pages from its product website.

hmrc-claiming.value: Fund Filer is included in HMRC's current list of commercial software suppliers for Charities Online.

editorial.assessment: Fund Filer is a specialised Gift Aid-management tool for churches and charities, not a general ledger or all-in-one church-management system. Its narrow focus may suit a church that wants to improve Gift Aid and GASDS administration without replacing its existing accounts package. The treasurer should test current donor imports, export options and hand-over process in the trial.
bestFor: Churches retaining a separate accounts package but needing a dedicated Gift Aid workflow
Giving secretaries who need to record donors and donations before preparing claims
Teams wanting a relatively low-cost, UK-focused starting point for Gift Aid administration
strengths: The supplier publishes a six-week trial and entry price
HMRC currently lists Fund Filer as a commercial Charities Online supplier
Public material describes Gift Aid, GASDS, reports and multiple users
limitations: It is not a full accounting or church-management platform
Confirm how existing donation data can be imported or exported
Review the current privacy, terms, backup, access and retention arrangements before importing donor records

procurementVerdict.problem: Gift Aid and GASDS administration becoming difficult to manage in spreadsheets
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A focused online claim-management tool for UK charities and churches
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Use the trial to run a representative donation record through the claim and finance-report workflow

sources.label: HMRC: Charities Online commercial software suppliers
